name: Floating Flamethrower AP OLD

stealth.note: +23 (expert) or @Check[perception|dc:38|traits:action:seek] (master) to notice the pattern of the orb's trajectory

description: A floating skull of fire swoops around the arena, rotating as it weaves through the ring and releasing huge gouts of flame in random directions.
disable: three DC 40 Thievery (legendary) checks or castings of Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 40), one each to pull out or disable the elemental cores hidden in the floating skull's right eye, left eye, and mouth
routine: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action per turn per successful check to disable. The floating flamethrower uses its first action to release a gout of flame in a 15ft Cone that deals (4d6+4) Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save), its second action to fly in a U-shape in a random direction, and its third action to release another gout of flame.

generalAbilities.name: Blaze
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Hao Jin signals the start of the bout

Effect The trap roars with fire and rolls initiative.
